title: Bound terminal find traversal work
goal: Prevent terminal find from traversing an unbounded number of workspace entries and accumulating unbounded results before output truncation.
context: Sources/Terminal/TerminalCore.swift limits recursive directory depth but has no global entry budget. A wide workspace can therefore make find consume excessive time and memory before the central output limit applies.
forbidden_changes: Do not change workspace path validation or symlink policy.
Do not alter find matching semantics for workspaces within the traversal budget.
Do not modify App/ or PersonalAgent.xcodeproj.
acceptance_criteria: Terminal find enforces both maximum directory depth and a global 4096-entry traversal budget.
Exceeding the entry budget fails with an actionable error instead of returning partial results.
A regression test verifies the entry budget rejects an oversized directory.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert the traversal budget change and regression test together if valid workspace searches exceed the documented limit in supported use cases.
